description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rev-parse' command with various parent revision options. It contains test cases that verify the correct behavior of revision parsing, including handling of commit references, parent revisions, and invalid inputs.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev_output
methods.description: Compares the output of 'git rev-parse' commands to expected values.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing between commits.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
